doc.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009

title: Pay in whiskey versus cash
summary: Dick Sherman's era was paid in whiskey; Andre's band wanted cash.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Well they do have a tradition here at Hamilton, but they don’t call it milk punch but it’s something. Dick Sherman told me that sometimes you guys got paid with a fifth of good whiskey. Is that true?
That was true. He graduated in ’53 you see. So I think back in the earlier 50s, that’s how they were paid. But no, we wanted cash. It was a little easier to choose our own booze
